keys.label: ONE_HAND_BACKSWING_LOAD
keys.causal_role: single overhead hand owns support while the root hangs behind the anchor; bent left knee and trailing free arm load an asymmetric backswing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pendular load behind anchor; hand support fixed

keys.label: UNDER_ANCHOR_SLING
keys.causal_role: root passes below the anchor before release; shoulder is long, left knee leads, and the free arm swings forward so support break is momentum-earned
keys.motion_arc_root_note: lowest pendulum point under fixed hand; forward tangent building

keys.label: FORWARD_TANGENT_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: right hand releases only after the root has crossed the anchor; body leaves on a specific up-right tangent while the released shoulder remains stretched behind
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support ends; ballistic root begins up-right from pendular tangent

keys.label: RISING_REACHBACK
keys.causal_role: root climbs while the just-released arm visibly lags behind the torso; legs split rather than folding symmetrically

keys.label: FORWARD_APEX_SPLIT
keys.causal_role: apex is a single sharp split silhouette: chest advances, lead leg opens downward, released shoulder still trails; no hover or second impulse

keys.label: APEX_EXIT_LEG_SWITCH
keys.causal_role: gravity wins immediately after apex; legs switch ownership and the torso rolls slightly forward instead of holding a poster pose

keys.label: DESCENT_SCISSOR_PREP
keys.causal_role: lead left leg lengthens under the falling COM while the right leg stays folded; arms counter-rotate to prepare a narrow first support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: gravity-earned descent; lead foot path steepens under COM

keys.label: LEFT_TOE_PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: left toe arrives beneath the pelvis before contact while the rear leg and released arm are still late; root continues down-forward
keys.motion_arc_root_note: precontact; no support yet; root still descending

keys.label: LEFT_TOE_FIRST_CATCH
keys.causal_role: left toe becomes the first floor constraint but does not freeze the body; root keeps dropping and traveling while the rear foot is still airborne

keys.label: RIGHT_WIDE_CATCH
keys.causal_role: right foot lands wide rather than stacking under the torso; the support polygon opens late while the released shoulder continues to overrun
keys.motion_arc_root_note: second support arrives; root sinks farther between unequal feet

keys.label: SPLIT_STANCE_DEBT_CRUSH
keys.causal_role: both feet stay unequally placed while pelvis drops to its lowest point and chest twists through; vertical debt is paid without a symmetric squat
keys.motion_arc_root_note: lowest root; forward travel nearly arrested by split support

keys.label: SHOULDER_LATE_REBOUND
keys.causal_role: ground reaction lifts the root before the released right shoulder catches up; free-arm swing overshoots across the chest as secondary debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: small rebound up-right; shoulder/arm lag remains

keys.label: LEAD_STEP_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: left foot releases into one forward step while the right foot owns support; torso is still canted from the overhead release rather than returning to idle
keys.motion_arc_root_note: forward re-entry begins from displaced support

keys.label: DISPLACED_FORWARD_REENTRY
keys.causal_role: left foot plants at a new address as the rear foot begins to unload; the right shoulder remains high and slightly late, preserving recovery debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: new-address readiness; no reverse interpolation to start

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: Landing support markers K8-K10 were several text rows above the floor, so first contact and split compression read as floating support theater rather than body-owned force transfer.
iterations.correction: Re-author A023-K7 through K13 with ground-constrained toe/foot coordinates, continued root drop after first contact, a materially wider unequal split catch, deeper oblique compression, and support-specific rebound/step release on the SAME Airborne023 body.

findings: fixed overhead hand support visibly owns the backswing and under-anchor sling before release
support break occurs after the root crosses the anchor and begins one continuous up-right ballistic arc
apex is brief; released shoulder and arm lag while legs switch asymmetrically
descent authors left-toe precontact before first support
first support does not freeze COM; root continues downward and the right foot arrives wide before deep oblique split compression
rebound lifts root before the released shoulder catches up; one forward re-entry step preserves displaced recovery debt
no floating contacts, symmetric squat, reverse interpolation, hover apex, or idle reset remains at acceptance scale

noodle_queen.taste: PASS — one-hand backswing, under-anchor sling, released-arm reachback, narrow toe catch, and wide split crush form distinct silhouette phases.
noodle_queen.function: PASS — support topology causally drives the sequence: hand support earns release; ballistic descent creates a narrow first support; late wide support pays vertical debt; shoulder lag remains after rebound.
noodle_queen.contempt: PASS — the performance is not a ground-jump reskin, wall/palm brace, hook catch, rider counterpitch, whiff landing, or stall/runout permutation; it does not read as endpoint-connected placeholder motion.
